name: Split AC Service & Repair
headline: Your split AC, cooling like the day it was installed
summary: Chennai runs on split ACs, and Chennai is hard on them. Sea air corrodes outdoor coils, road dust chokes filters, and 40°C afternoons punish weak compressors. Airam services both units on every visit — background-verified technicians, upfront pricing from ₹499, and up to a 90-day warranty on repairs.

symptoms.title: Weak or warm airflow
symptoms.description: Clogged filters and dirty coils are the usual culprits, and Chennai's road dust builds up faster than most owners expect.

symptoms.title: Musty smell on startup
symptoms.description: Coastal humidity breeds mould on the evaporator coil, and the blower pushes it into the room every time the unit starts.

symptoms.title: Water dripping indoors
symptoms.description: A blocked drain line or tilted tray sends condensate down your wall instead of out the pipe, especially during monsoon damp.

symptoms.title: Rattling outdoor unit
symptoms.description: Loose fan blades, worn mounts or a straining compressor get louder under 40°C load and rarely fix themselves.

symptoms.title: Ice on the copper pipes
symptoms.description: Frost on the lines points to low refrigerant or restricted airflow, and running the unit that way risks the compressor.

symptoms.title: Bills up, cooling down
symptoms.description: A split AC fighting dirty coils draws noticeably more power to deliver less cold air than it did last summer.

faqs.question: How often should a split AC be serviced in Chennai?
faqs.answer: Twice a year is the honest answer for this city. Book a deep clean before summer peaks in April, and a basic service once the monsoon damp clears. Homes near the coast or on busy roads may need a mid-cycle filter clean as well.

faqs.question: What is the difference between the basic service and the deep clean?
faqs.answer: The basic service from ₹499 covers filter washing, coil brushing and a drain check, and suits units cleaned within the last six months. The deep clean from ₹999 uses foam and a jet wash to strip grime from the evaporator and condenser coils, the blower wheel and the drain line. If your AC smells musty or the airflow feels weak, choose the deep clean.

faqs.question: Do you service my brand of split AC?
faqs.answer: Yes. We work on Daikin, LG, Voltas, Blue Star, Samsung, Carrier, Hitachi, O General, Mitsubishi Electric and Panasonic units. Our technicians carry common spares for these brands, which keeps most jobs to a single visit.

faqs.question: Will I be charged more than the quoted price?
faqs.answer: No. You approve an upfront quote before work begins, and anything discovered mid-job is priced and approved separately before we touch it. Your digital GST invoice itemises every line.

faqs.question: What does the service warranty cover?
faqs.answer: Repairs carry up to a 90-day service warranty, with the exact period for your job noted on the invoice. If the same fault recurs within that window, we return and set it right at no charge. Routine wear, voltage-surge damage and unrelated faults sit outside it.
